FIG.01 — REAL-TIME NETWORK
[ 01 ] — SELECTED WORK

Two crafts. One obsession with worlds.

[ 02 ] — MANIFESTO

A filmmaker who thinks in polygons. A 3D artist who thinks in shots.

CHAPTER 01

The Dual Discipline

Sixteen years behind cameras — directing, shooting and grading — taught me how light, rhythm and framing move people. Real-time 3D gave me a second language for the same ideas. I work fluently in both, and each makes the other sharper.

CHAPTER 02

Worlds Built to Perform

Beautiful is not enough. Every asset I ship is game-ready: clean topology, honest PBR, disciplined UVs, optimized for the frame budget. Environments are designed around the player's eye — composition first, polycount always in mind.

CHAPTER 03

Global Readiness

Based in Portugal, eligible to work across the EU, fluent in English, native in Portuguese. Looking for studios — in Lisbon, London, Berlin, Montreal or remote — where I can grow inside a professional production pipeline and contribute from day one.
